random_vs_honest_split.detail: primary metrics use honest quota near-dup split (Jaccard 0.8); random-split numbers kept only as leaky baselines and labeled

threshold_not_tuned_on_test.detail: selective thresholds and temperature fit on calibration only; test never tunes coverage

duplicate_near_duplicate_leakage.note: Round3 also reports cross-split Jaccard pairs below 0.75

calibration_independent_of_test.detail: quota split yields disjoint train/cal/test component groups; cal used for temperature + selective thresholds only

class_imbalance.note: infection/derm dominate; 呼吸内科 recall=0 in seed42; accuracy must be read with per-dept recall

robustness_not_overclaimed.detail: robustness uses meaning-preserving synthetic perturbations only; labeled robustness_simulation, not clinical robustness

verdict: metrics are honest for offline research; several limitations must stay visible in materials
